player_prompt.intro:
Galoi shagu Frozen Lake de!

Nang 'P' hpe grid hta grai hkawm ai.
Grid laika:
  ' ' = Ngai hkru du (hkru du hkawm yang she)
  'H' = Hka (du yang gawp na!)
  'G' = Tang madu (tang madu hkawm yang shanu!)
  'P' = Nang hkawm ai shiga

Kaja ai laika: up, down, left, right (w, a, s, d)
Laika hkawm ai hpe: [up], [down], [left], [right] wu [w], [a], [s], [d]

Tang madu: Hka tsaw ra (hkru du) nang hpe shanu de du hkawm ai hte, hka ra (hkru du) nang hpe shanu de du hkawm ai hte, hka hpe shanu yang gawp na!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Laika hkawm ai hpe shanhte. [up], [down], [left], [right] wu [w], [a], [s], [d] hkawm ai.
invalid_move.unknown_action: N chye ai bungli '{action}'. Up, down, left, right or w, a, s, d hpe lang u.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Nang gaw {action} hku shalawp nna hkrai hkrai e shalawp hta shingkang hku hta du hkraa!

game_action.moved: Nang kaja wa na {action} hte hpe ({row}, {col}) tangka ahkye.

outcome.win: Kabu gara ai lam! Nang bandung du wa sai.
outcome.fell_in_hole: Nang gaw hku hta du hkraa! Hpung hkam. Nang gaw {pct}% mungdan a lam hku byin hkraa.
outcome.turn_limit: Nang gaw hkrai hkrai e shalawp hku hta shingkang! Hpung hkam. Nang gaw {pct}% mungdan a lam hku byin hkraa.
